{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from Slurm)

# Slurm requested:
#   --job-name=land_use
#   --account=POLARIS
#   --partition=bdwall
#   --nodes=1
#   --time=30:00:00
#   --mail-user=jauld@anl.gov
#   --mail-type=ALL

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  --time=30h \
  --queue=bdwall \
  bash -lc '

# NOTE: Slurm --account=POLARIS has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but accounting/charging/allocation association may be incorrect.

# NOTE: Slurm email notifications (--mail-user/--mail-type=ALL) have no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but you will not receive job emails.

# NOTE: Slurm --job-name=land_use is not expressed here as a portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

set -eu

main() {
    cd /lcrc/project/POLARIS/bebop/SMART_FY22_LAND_USE/PILATES-SRC-JA
    module_load
    setup_venv
    . venv/bin/activate
    python3 ./run.py "$@"
}

setup_venv() {
    python3 -m pip install --user virtualenv
    [[ -d venv ]] || virtualenv venv
    . venv/bin/activate
    # python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
}

module_load() {
    module load gcc/10.2.0-z53hda3
    module load python/3.8.10-6kl7zkj
    module load singularity/3.6.4

    python3 -m ensurepip --upgrade
}

main "$@"
' -- "$@"
"
}
